title: Fix slow loading / stuck permissions check on Admin Dashboard

requirements.summary: Resolve indefinitely-hanging 'Berechtigungen werden geprüft' loading state on AdminDashboard by ensuring the permission check completes quickly and either grants access or shows an appropriate message
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Berechtigungen werden geprüft' loading screen resolves within 3 seconds after the page mounts.
If the user is an admin, the admin dashboard tabs (Collections, NFTs) are displayed after the check.
If the user is not an admin or not authenticated, an appropriate message or redirect is shown rather than an endless spinner.
No infinite loading state or unresolved promise occurs under any authentication state (logged in, logged out, actor unavailable).

file_operations.description: Replace the current permission check logic with a robust implementation that includes a hard timeout mechanism (5 seconds maximum). Add early return for unauthenticated users. Ensure the loading state resolves to either admin access granted, access denied message, or timeout error state. Add error boundary handling for actor initialization failures. Display appropriate German-language messages for each state (loading, access denied, timeout, error).

requirements.summary: Ensure useIsCallerAdmin hook always resolves within a reasonable timeout and handles unauthenticated state immediately
acceptanceCriteria: The hook settles (returns a non-pending result) within at most 5 seconds regardless of backend actor state.
When unauthenticated, the hook immediately returns false rather than waiting for an actor call.
A timeout mechanism (e.g. 5 s) causes the hook to resolve as false/error rather than staying in isLoading state.

file_operations.description: Create a new wrapper hook that adds timeout and early-exit logic around the existing useIsCallerAdmin hook. Check authentication state from useInternetIdentity before attempting the actor call. If not authenticated, immediately return { isAdmin: false, isLoading: false, error: null }. If authenticated, race the existing useIsCallerAdmin query against a 5-second timeout using Promise.race. On timeout, return { isAdmin: false, isLoading: false, error: new Error('Admin check timed out') }. Export the hook for use in AdminDashboard.

requirements.summary: Ensure useActor hook surfaces errors promptly and dependent hooks react correctly to unavailable actor state
acceptanceCriteria: The actor hook does not remain in a loading state if the Internet Identity session is not present.
An error state is surfaced (not swallowed) when actor creation fails.
Dependent hooks (useIsCallerAdmin, useGetCallerUserProfile) react correctly to an unavailable actor and do not block page rendering.

file_operations.description: Add explicit checks for actor availability and error states from the useActor hook. If actor is unavailable or in error state after a brief delay (1-2 seconds), display an error message in German explaining the connection issue. Ensure the page does not remain in loading state when actor initialization fails. Add fallback UI for actor errors that allows the user to retry or navigate away.
